subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased into the current depth-aware sub-agent delegation prompt, or should current main's existing prompt policy supersede it?
rationale: The remaining choice is prompt-policy ownership: current main already has a newer canonical delegation surface, while this PR adds another rubric with behavior-changing wording for nested sub-agents.

options.title: Consolidate into current prompt policy
options.body: Rebase and move any still-desired task-selection wording into the existing `subagentDelegationMode` and depth-aware sub-agent prompt sections, preserving current tool/depth gates.

options.title: Close as superseded by current main
options.body: Keep the current consolidated prompt policy and close this branch if maintainers do not want the extra rubric.

options.title: Accept duplicate guidance intentionally
options.body: Merge a rebased version only if maintainers explicitly want both Tooling-level and delegation-mode guidance despite the prompt drift risk.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into current prompt policy
recommendation.body: Rebase and move any still-desired task-selection wording into the existing `subagentDelegationMode` and depth-aware sub-agent prompt sections, preserving current tool/depth gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame points to Vincent Koc for the consolidated sub-agent prompt policy this PR now overlaps.
